name: tunelink
description: Self-hosted MCP server for connecting AI assistants with Spotify.

scripts.format: prettier --write src tests scripts examples docs .github eslint.config.js .prettierrc.json tsconfig.json package.json "*.md" "*.yml"
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests scripts examples docs .github eslint.config.js .prettierrc.json tsconfig.json package.json "*.md" "*.yml"
scripts.docs:dev: npm run docs:generate && vitepress dev docs
scripts.docs:build: npm run docs:generate && vitepress build docs
scripts.check: npm run docs:generate && npm run docs:check && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run docs:build
scripts.docs:generate: tsx scripts/generate-docs.ts && prettier --write docs/environment-reference.md docs/tools-reference.md docs/pl/environment-reference.md docs/pl/tools-reference.md docs/de/environment-reference.md docs/de/tools-reference.md docs/fr/environment-reference.md docs/fr/tools-reference.md docs/es/environment-reference.md docs/es/tools-reference.md
